Quick answers:
- Pilot economics: We commonly offer a blended approach — a set of pilot credits (one-time) that cover usage plus a short-term committed band with a modest discount if you want predictable capacity. For ~500k tokens/mo over 3 months we typically propose $X credits + up to 10% off list on a 3-month minimum commit (we'll put exact numbers into a short SOW).
- Technical scope: Our Optimize toolkit pilot usually includes a one-page recommendation on quantization profile (FP16 vs 8-bit per-layer guidance), and a batching/cache configuration template. If you want hands-on tuning in your VPC (we'd run small perf tests and tune batch sizing/KV cache policies) we recommend adding a 10–20 hour engineering engagement.
- Private deployment: VPC/private control plane is supported; there can be a setup fee for network onboarding and certificate/KMS integration depending on account size. No extra per-token surcharge — just one-time provisioning and optional extended logs retention fees.

Vanessa / Connor / Priya — quick technical + commercial framing from my side.

Technical recommendations (short):
- Quantization: For the 6B models we recommend 8-bit per-channel asymmetric quantization (Q4_0/Q4_1 style) for the pilot to get the best cost/quality tradeoff. For 13B we suggest mixed strategy: FP16 for attention layers + 8-bit for feed-forward where latency sensitivity is lower. We'll produce a 1-pg "Quantization Recommendation" that lists expected perf uplift and rough quality delta (we'll include sample token-level evals).
- Batching/cache: Start with conservative max batch of 8 and dynamic batching windows tuned to a 30–50ms tail SLO. Enable prefix/response KV caching on stable prompt prefixes (we'll provide a cache keying template). That should reduce token compute by ~20–35% depending on reuse.
- VPC ops: We'll need one week for onboarding (network setup, KMS cert exchange) and a second week to run perf passes and capture KV/cache profiles. The hands-on tuning is estimated at 12–18 eng hours.

Commercial framing (suggested SOW language):
- Pilot scope includes: one-time pilot credits equivalent to $X of usage, delivery of the Quantization Recommendation (1 page) and Batching/Cache template, and up to 12 hours of remote engineering support for perf testing in a customer-managed VPC.
- Optional add-on: extended hands-on tuning (10 additional hours) and on-site support if required.
- Pricing: recommend structuring as: 80% credits + 20% short-term committed band at a 7–10% discount to list for the pilot period. If they convert to a 12-month committed contract within 60 days of pilot completion, apply a conversion credit equal to unused pilot credits.
